title: Night owls
statementMd:
Count plays between midnight and 05:59 for each plan.

Expected columns: `plan`, `night_plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT l.plan, COUNT(*) AS night_plays FROM plays p JOIN listeners l ON l.id = p.listener_id WHERE strftime('%H', p.played_at) < '06' GROUP BY l.plan;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
